company.name: Codly
company.shortDescription: Create UI source code directly from photoshop design.
company.description:
Codly is a platform that aims to accelerate mobile application development. It generates UI source code directly from photoshop using Codly photoshop extension. 

It also provide the designer with a preview application that enables him to preview his design as real, native components. It also gives him the advantage of sharing his application in development with other team members or client to get approval on the design.

Right now, we are generating UI source code for Titanium SDK, but in the upcoming versions, we will be supporting Android and Swift SDKs.
